name: Strong Mayfly 90
author: bociKond
description: Gradient red pattern with gradient fill with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: It has no hover, click, focus or animation states; the pattern is a fixed design.
css:
/* Strong Mayfly 90 by bociKond — https://uiverse.io/bociKond/strong-mayfly-90 */
.container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: radial-gradient(
      50% 50% at 100% 0,
      #ca3f3f 0% 5%,
      #ffffff 6% 15%,
      #ca3f3f 16% 25%,
      #ffffff 26% 35%,
      #ca3f3f 36% 45%,
      #ffffff 46% 55%,
      #ca3f3f 56% 65%,
      #ffffff 66% 75%,
      #ca3f3f 76% 85%,
      #ffffff 86% 95%,
      #0000 96%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      50% 50% at 0 100%,
      #ca3f3f 0% 5%,
      #ffffff 6% 15%,
      #ca3f3f 16% 25%,
      #ffffff 26% 35%,
      #ca3f3f 36% 45%,
      #ffffff 46% 55%,
      #ca3f3f 56% 65%,
      #ffffff 66% 75%,
      #ca3f3f 76% 85%,
      #ffffff 86% 95%,
      #0000 96%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      50% 50%,
      #ca3f3f 0% 5%,
      #ffffff 6% 15%,
      #ca3f3f 16% 25%,
      #ffffff 26% 35%,
      #ca3f3f 36% 45%,
      #ffffff 46% 55%,
      #ca3f3f 56% 65%,
      #ffffff 66% 75%,
      #ca3f3f 76% 85%,
      #ffffff 86% 95%,
      #0000 96%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
        50% 50%,
        #ca3f3f 0% 5%,
        #ffffff 6% 15%,
        #ca3f3f 16% 25%,
        #ffffff 26% 35%,
        #ca3f3f 36% 45%,
        #ffffff 46% 55%,
        #ca3f3f 56% 65%,
        #ffffff 66% 75%,
        #ca3f3f 76% 85%,
        #ffffff 86% 95%,
        #0000 96%
      )
      38px 38px;
  background-size: 76px 76px;
  background-color: #ca3f3f;
}
